doc_name: 国家集成电路产业发展推进纲要
issuer: 工业和信息化部等（经国务院同意/批准印发；人民日报、新华社报道为"国务院印发"）
quote_zh: 为加快推进我国集成电路产业发展，特制定本纲要
quote_en: To speed up China's integrated-circuit industry, this outline is hereby formulated.
notes: Dedicated national outline. Targets: 2015 sales above RMB 350bn; 2020 annual growth above 20%; 2030 chain at advanced level; 16/14nm volume production by 2020. Also 国家产业投资基金, tax support under 国发〔2000〕18号 and 国发〔2011〕4号.
